    "Model forecasts are systematically below true outcomes, showing a consistent under-forecast bias of approximately 1-2 euros",
    "The gap between model and true values increases over the 30-day horizon as sentiment momentum builds",
    "When current sentiment is positive ( > 0.33 ), model forecasts need upward correction to match the delayed sentiment effect",
    "When current sentiment is negative ( < 0.33 ), model forecasts overestimate prices relative to true values",
    "Sentiment turning from positive to negative causes an immediate forecast correction downward",
    "Prolonged positive sentiment (continuous 1.00) requires forecast extrapolation beyond current trends",
    "Model naturally under-captures price reversals, especially when sentiment flips from negative to positive"
